title: Validate RF layout: SX1262 matching network and antenna path

context_files.reason: RF pin assignments and antenna net

acceptance_criteria: SX1262 RF_OUT (pin 3) → L4 (3.9nH) → C31 (0.8pF) → ANT net → J3 test point
SX1262 RF_IN (pin 2) → C32 (1pF to GND shunt) → ANT net
RF trace impedance: 50Ω coplanar waveguide with ground pour on both sides
No vias on RF trace between SX1262 and antenna
Ground pour around RF trace with stitching vias (λ/20 spacing ~ 3mm at 915MHz)
L4 (3.9nH) and C31 (0.8pF) footprints: 0402, placed close to SX1262 pins
C32 (1pF) shunt to GND placed at RF_IN pin
Antenna test point J3 accessible for u.FL connector option
SX1262 VDD pins (12-22) have decoupling: 100nF + 1µF + 4.7µF near pins
TCXO pin (28) tied to GND (using internal 32MHz XO per design)
DIO1/DIO2/DIO3 routed to MCU with minimal length
deliverables: Annotated PCB screenshots of RF section
